component.name: Linux Island
component.summary: Dynamic Island-style status capsule for Linux desktops

description.p: Linux Island places a Dynamic Island-style capsule at the top of the screen. It shows now-playing media, quick settings, system metrics, AI quota and notifications without taking over the desktop.
On GNOME 45 to 50 the capsule is drawn by a native Shell extension. Other desktops run the Qt overlay through XWayland, optionally refined by the shipped KWin, Sway or Hyprland window rules.
